extracted.intended_audience: SEP holders, implementers, standardisation organisations, SMEs, policymakers and other SEP stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and proposed regulatory framework for the governance, transparency and licensing of Standard Essential Patents (SEPs) in the EU, including registration, essentiality checks, FRAND determination, aggregate royalties and SME support.

rubrics_metrics.name: SEP reform objectives (innovation and competitiveness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring that both EU SEP owners and implementers innovate in the EU, make and sell products in the EU and are competitive in non-EU markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The SEP reform aims for a balanced framework to incentivise participation by European firms in the standard development process and the broad implementation of standardised technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: SEP reform objectives (end-user benefits and reasonable prices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring that end users, including SMEs and consumers, benefit from products based on the latest standardised technologies at reasonable prices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the two stated objectives of the proposal is to secure affordable access for end users while maintaining incentives for innovation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishment of a Competence Centre at EUIPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Creation of a 'Competence Centre' at the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO) to administer the registry, essentiality checks, FRAND determination, and SME support services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Competence Centre is the administrative hub for the proposal's building blocks (registry, checks, FRAND process, SME services) and is intended to centralise SEP-related services.

rubrics_metrics.name: SEP registration (obligatory register)
rubrics_metrics.description: Establishment of an obligatory register where SEP holders record their SEPs, providing details on patent and standard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The register is intended to improve transparency by requiring SEP holders to provide details linking patents to standards; access and reduced-fee measures for SMEs are foreseen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Essentiality checks (selected SEPs, annual checks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Selected SEPs recorded in the register are subject to an annual essentiality check.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Essentiality checks are a procedural safeguard to verify whether declared patents are actually essential to the standard; the proposal foresees checks on selected records on an annual basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: FRAND determination (mandatory pre-litigation procedure)
rubrics_metrics.description: A FRAND determination procedure aiming to help SEP owners and implementers agree on a FRAND licence; the FRAND determination of maximum 9 months is mandatory before a SEP owner or an implementer goes to Court.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This provides a safe harbour for negotiations without the threat of litigation or delaying tactics and is designed to promote settlement and predictability in licence negotiations.

rubrics_metrics.name: SEP aggregate royalty rate (notification or conciliator recommendation)
rubrics_metrics.description: SEP holders and implementers may notify the expected maximum aggregate royalty to the Competence Centre; alternatively, parties can ask a conciliator to recommend a (non-binding) aggregate royalty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This mechanism is intended to increase predictability about total royalty burdens for implementers and to facilitate discussions on aggregate rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: SME support measures
rubrics_metrics.description: Free advisory services, reduced fees for registration of SEPs and for essentiality checks and access to the SEP register, and promoting more favourable FRAND terms and conditions for SMEs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures are targeted to help smaller players and new entrants (start-ups, SMEs) navigate SEP licensing, lowering administrative and financial barriers and encouraging fairer terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in SEP negotiations
rubrics_metrics.description: Contribute to a more transparent environment for negotiations between SEP holders and potential licensees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transparency (e.g., via registration and clear processes) is presented as key to legal certainty and smoother, faster licensing outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common valuation principles for SEP technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose common valuation principles for SEP technology to improve predictability and comparability of SEP valuations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 2017 Communication suggested common valuation principles as part of a holistic approach to ease licensing and provide clearer expectations for royalties and value allocation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balanced and predictable enforcement regime
rubrics_metrics.description: Suggest ideas for a balanced and predictable enforcement regime governing SEP disputes and remedies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A predictable enforcement framework is intended to incentivise contribution of technology to standards while ensuring implementers have smooth access to standardised technologies; this aims to reduce strategic litigation and uncertainty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smooth licensing environment as success criterion
rubrics_metrics.description: A smooth licensing environment that achieves broad and rapid diffusion of innovation, gives patent holders an adequate return on R&D, and gives users fair access at a reasonable cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page frames a successful standard/licensing ecosystem by these three outcomes (diffusion, adequate return, fair/affordable access) as interdependent goals of the regulatory framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on Internet of Things (IoT) and new players' needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Special attention to IoT industries and to new players unfamiliar with SEP licensing (including start-ups and SMEs) who may face particular challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Commission intends the framework and expert work to address specific challenges in IoT deployment and to provide tools to help new entrants conclude fast, effective and fair SEP licensing arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-litigation dispute-resolution emphasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural emphasis on resolving FRAND/royalty disputes through administrative/conciliatory mechanisms (registration, FRAND determination, conciliator recommendations) before litigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mandatory FRAND determination before court and conciliator options for aggregate royalty rates are designed as alternatives to immediate litigation, creating a structured negotiation pathway.
